Class OutputSnapshot

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.change.OutputSnapshot
public final class OutputSnapshot extends Object
The contents of the reloadable output directories at one moment: every class file by binary name and every other file by relative path, each with a digest of its bytes. Two snapshots tell what a compilation, embedded or by the build tool, changed.
Since:
5.3.0
